tools.name: population_compile
tools.description: Inspect diagnostic SQL and the bound definition/snapshot hashes without executing. Same list encoding as population_query; empty metrics selects objects and requires empty dimensions. Diagnostic SQL needs an internal AST dependency and cannot be replayed as ordinary SQL. A separate call after operator reload may bind a different snapshot; compare the execution envelope hashes, including empty results.

tools.name: population_query
tools.description: Aggregate a discovered concept. Read metrics, fields and capabilities first. Lists are JSON-encoded string arrays. Result is a single result_json carrier: parse ossie-population-result-v1 columns and row arrays. Integer/Decimal cells are exact strings, IEEE float cells are approximate strings with explicit non-finite values; NULL stays null. Check snapshot hashes even for empty results. Groups are sparse, unsorted and unpaged; combined requests bind separately.

tools.name: population_objects
tools.description: List objects in an exact discovered concept. filters is a JSON-encoded array of predicate strings; use "[]" for none. Filters only narrow the formal rule. Result is a single result_json carrier: parse it as ossie-population-result-v1 with bound column types and row arrays. Numeric cells are strings, NULL stays null. Results are unsorted and unpaged; even empty results carry snapshot hashes.
